summary_zh: 已按生产快照逐函数重建城市补丁，两文件精确正反向校验通过，14项恢复测试通过；扩展回归95项中94通过、1项静态扫描失败，原开发副本同项复现。独立审核、登记、部署与真实城市验收待完成。
summary_en: Rebuilt the city patch function by function against pinned production snapshots. Both files pass exact forward/reverse checks and all 14 recovery tests pass. Expanded regression: 94/95 passed; the static-scan failure also reproduces on the original development tree. Independent review, registration, deployment and production city acceptance remain pending.
scope_zh: 仅生产两文件的有界恢复方法及必要辅助函数，保留生产其余代码与identity_review分支。
scope_en: Only bounded recovery methods and required helpers in two production files; preserve other production code and identity_review branch.
correction_zh: 上轮retail的PATCH_HUNK_COUNT_INVALID来自诊断调用遗漏expected_hunks参数（默认3），不是补丁语法错误；discovery生产上下文差异仍真实存在。本轮传真实块数并精确正反向校验。
correction_en: Prior retail PATCH_HUNK_COUNT_INVALID came from the diagnostic omitting expected_hunks (default 3), not malformed patch syntax. Discovery production context incompatibility was real. This cycle supplies actual hunk counts for exact forward/reverse checks.
